title: Building in the Gemini Era – Kat Kampf & Ammaar Reshi, Google DeepMind
talk_summary: A Google DeepMind product demo of Gemini 3 Pro and Nano Banana Pro inside AI Studio's vibe-coding experience, showing one-shot app generation, image/text rendering, and a live multiplayer game. It is almost entirely product marketing and live demos with no engineering methodology, harness design, or measured workflow results.

takeaways.technique: One-shot UI cloning from a screenshot
takeaways.what_they_do: They feed a screenshot of an existing app plus a short instruction to clone the UI and add an export flow, letting the model infer layout and styling rather than specifying it.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I said, "Clone this UI as closely as possible and then add a flow to export to our anti-gravity app."

takeaways.what_they_do: They add negative style constraints (e.g. 'no cyberpunk') to steer away from the model's default aesthetic, which they say otherwise produces generic purple gradients.
takeaways.evidence_quote: kind of actually did say no cyber puncture
